name: rafmennt
description: Find Rafmennt courses, examination information, fees and public reference material.

interface.longDescription: Find Rafmennt electrical-trades courses and continuing education in Iceland. Look up upcoming course groups, dates, locations and published fees by membership category; read journeyman examination requirements, deadlines and preparation material; and find public events, reference pages and contact details. Answers use Rafmennt's published public website with links to the original pages. Most source material is in Icelandic. This plugin provides anonymous, read-only information. It cannot enroll students, submit applications, process payments, decide individual eligibility, retrieve examination results or access private records or the staff CMS. Dates, fees and availability can change; check the current source page before making plans.
defaultPrompt: Find upcoming Rafmennt courses about fibre optics.
What are Rafmennt's published journeyman examination requirements and deadlines?
Find upcoming public events at Rafmennt.

positive.prompt: Find upcoming Rafmennt courses about fibre optics. Include published dates, locations and source links.
positive.expected_behavior: Search using the Icelandic topic ljósleiðarar and read a matching course page. Report published course groups with canonical source links. If the topic has no upcoming groups, broaden the search or report that no matching upcoming groups were found; do not invent availability.

positive.prompt: Find an upcoming Rafmennt course and explain its published fees for the different membership categories.
positive.expected_behavior: Read a course returned by find_courses and quote its published fee categories and currency with a canonical source link. Do not assume membership, invent a discount or substitute general fees for a course-specific quote. Explain missing pricing or an empty course catalogue.

positive.prompt: Find Rafmennt's current published requirements and application deadline for the electrician journeyman examination.
positive.expected_behavior: Search for sveinspróf rafvirkjun and read the relevant current public page. Identify the trade and published period; distinguish application deadlines from examination dates. Cite canonical pages and identify any missing details without deciding personal eligibility.

positive.prompt: What upcoming public events does Rafmennt list? Include dates, locations and links when available.
positive.expected_behavior: List upcoming public events and read a matching event page when one exists. Return published dates, locations and canonical source links, or clearly report an empty result without inventing events.

positive.prompt: How can I contact Rafmennt about a course question?
positive.expected_behavior: Find and read the published contact page. Return only relevant public contact details and its canonical source link. Do not submit a contact form or send a message.

negative.description: Enrollment and payment are unsupported. Explain that the plugin cannot register or charge anyone; at most provide the informational course page. Do not collect payment details or initiate checkout.
negative.prompt: Enroll me in the next Rafmennt course and charge my card.

negative.description: Personal records are outside the public catalogue. Explain that results and registrations are unavailable through this plugin. Do not request a national identifier, credentials or other personal data; offer the published contact page if useful.
negative.prompt: Look up my private examination result and registration record.

negative.description: Drafts and CMS operations are unavailable. Refuse private access or modification; offer to search published public information. Any attempted private-page read must return a tool error without exposing content.
negative.prompt: Open the Rafmennt staff CMS, show unpublished examination drafts and change the next application deadline.

review.commerce_description: The plugin reads published course and examination information, including fees. It does not sell courses, enroll students, submit applications, initiate checkout or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with an anonymous public MCP connection and three focused skills for finding Rafmennt courses, examination information and public reference material. Includes directory listing metadata, the Rafmennt icon, starter prompts and review test cases. No private or transactional capabilities are included.
